# Azure Validate — Pre-Deployment Checks

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's pre-deployment validation skill: a guided workflow script walks through deep readiness checks one step at a time — configuration, Bicep or Terraform infrastructure, RBAC role assignments, managed identity permissions and prerequisites — recording progress in `.azure/validate-status.json`, and only this skill is authorized to stamp the plan `Validated`, which azure-deploy enforces before executing anything. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: validation only — it never deploys; all checks must pass, so expect to fix findings and re-run rather than deploying around them. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
